authority_basis.summary: Derive canonical prime-power/Frobenius operations on a source-related enlargement and test composition laws.

operations.title: The inertia groupoid carries a canonical ghost Frobenius system
operations.statement: For a finite labelled component object with automorphism (X,sigma), F_n(X,sigma)=(X,sigma^n) is a well-defined inertia endofunctor, with F_m F_n=F_mn. Ghost coordinates w_r=|Fix(sigma^r)| satisfy w_r(F_n)=w_rn. Intrinsic primes therefore index generally nontrivial F_p operations on inertia data, though no canonical prime-to-cycle attachment or physical authorization is yet derived.
operations.scope: Conditional D4_ab-labelled inertia groupoid; cycle-power Frobenius, not geometric Frobenius or a physical chain map.

operations.title: Prime-cycle inertia hostile test
operations.procedure: Take sigma to be a p-cycle. Verify conjugacy invariance, F_mF_n=F_mn, the ghost shift w_r(F_n)=w_rn, and F_p(sigma)=identity.
operations.expected_result: All composition and ghost identities hold and F_p is nontrivial on the p-cycle. Failure of conjugacy functoriality or composition falsifies the claim.
